meta.title: SUtech Transport
meta.description: Book your seat on the university bus, track it live and show your digital card.

common.notFoundBody: Check the link or go back home.

errors.FORBIDDEN: This account isn't allowed to do that.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some details are missing or invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: The server sent an unexpected reply. Tell the transport office if it keeps happening.
errors.INVALID_OTP: Wrong code. Check it and try again.
errors.OTP_LOCKED: The code is locked after 3 wrong tries. Ask for a new one.
errors.UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER: This number isn't registered. Check it, or contact student affairs.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is turned off. Contact the transport office.
errors.SEAT_UNAVAILABLE: This line is full. Pick another line.
errors.ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED: You already have a subscription or booking.
errors.SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Only active subscribers can do this.
errors.RESERVATION_EXPIRED: Your reservation expired or isn't waiting for payment. Book again.
errors.DUPLICATE_REFERENCE: This transaction reference was already used.
errors.OPEN_REQUEST_EXISTS: You already have an open request. Wait for it to finish.
errors.INVALID_STATE: Things changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.CARD_INVALID: This card isn't valid (cancelled or not genuine).
errors.CARD_EXPIRED: The code expired. Ask the student to reopen their card.
errors.WRONG_LINE: This student isn't on this line.
errors.SOS_ALREADY_OPEN: There's already an open SOS; the office is on it.
errors.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: At least one super admin must stay active.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something unexpected happened. Try again in a moment.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.heading: Welcome
auth.subheading: Sign in to book and track your bus.
auth.identifierHint: Students use their 9-digit university ID. Parents and staff use their account ID.
auth.wrongCode: Wrong code. Enter the 4 digits you received.

demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.body: Pick an account to fill its ID, then ask for the code.
